headlines.title: Iran's IRGC Navy says two tankers 'exploded' after hitting mines in Hormuz
headlines.summary: Tankers hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz is the kind of tape that stops the floor cold — roughly 20% of global oil supply transits that chokepoint. Even with diplomacy headlines softening crude today, a physical incident in Hormuz puts an instant bid under oil and hammers airlines, refiners, and any consumer-facing name with a fuel cost line. Watch USO, XLE, and the long bond for the flight-to-safety move.

headlines.title: Alphabet Shares Fall 13% After Earnings Miss; Search Revenue Growth Slows to 12%
headlines.summary: A 13% drop in Alphabet is not a rounding error — that's a $200-billion-plus market cap evaporating in a session, and it drags the whole AI-ad complex with it. When the king of search stumbles, Meta's relative outperformance becomes the story, and every hyperscaler gets repriced as the Street asks who's next to disappoint on AI monetization. QQQ feels this one in the gut.

headlines.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows as withdrawals resume after massive hack
headlines.summary: A $6.3 billion hack at the world's largest crypto exchange followed by $3.64 billion in net outflows is the kind of confidence-shaking event that sends Bitcoin and the whole crypto complex into a tailspin — think FTX echoes. Contagion risk to crypto-adjacent equities like Coinbase and MicroStrategy is real, and retail sentiment in digital assets could crater fast. The dollar headline stabilizing bitcoin mentioned elsewhere looks increasingly fragile.
